_doc: Sects & Missions, the member's side (design/gdd/sects.md rules 19-22, 25; Formulas F10, F12, F13). standing_events: F10's e values (a gain is smoothed by 1 - St/100 when St >= 0; a fall is taken in full). desertion: the fall and the ceiling standing is then set to (F10). ally_share: share of a fall the sect's allies and vassals take (F10; none exist until pacts and vassalage are built). hostile_threshold: Quests hostile_threshold, the standing at or below which the sect treats the player as hostile and will not sell or recruit (F11). recruit_line_base / recruit_line_per_dial: the recruit line 20 - 10 x Recruitment (F11). default_dials: PROVISIONAL stance dials (0-4) every sect uses until the stance dials of rule 12 are built. join_realm_floor: lowest realm index a sect recruits (rule 20). rank_names: how each rank of the ladder (world_generation.json sects.rank_ladder) is shown. contribution_per_cash: F12 c_share, contribution per linh thach of a sect mission's cash. promotion: F13 gates of a great sect for each rank reached by promotion (realm index, contribution spent, standing); the head seat is not reached by promotion (rule 28: an open seat or a trial).

economy._doc: Sects & Missions' development and money (design/gdd/sects.md Formulas F1, F2, F4, F17, F19; SectEconomy). c0, g: F1's cost of level 1 and growth; u: upkeep a season as a share of the total invested; w_v: weight of vassals' investment in a great sect's effective level. mix_*: F19's mix (War readiness sets the Military share; the rest split Holdings 0.25 : Institutions 0.20 : Trade 0.25). cap_base, i: F2's seat capacity. r_floor, r_ceil, pay_by_state: F4's tribute. unpaid_seasons_to_fall, trouble_seasons: F1's fall and F19's 4-season priority. intake_target, rec_k: F17. desert_share: Sects F3's stipend-shortfall desertions: the share of a sect's Luyện Khí members who leave (become loose) in a season it could not pay its stipends in full (guess).

masters._doc: Sects rule 20a (user decision 2026-11-21): a newcomer gets a master with World Generation's master_share; the master is a higher-realm member with fewer than disciples_max living disciples, weighted 1 + rank index.

politics._doc: Sects & Missions' politics (design/gdd/sects.md Formulas F5-F9, F18, States; SectPolitics). F7: align_same / align_opposed, b_k per shared border region, p_k for a pact, k_a, pact_line (both ways) with pact_hysteresis, feud_line (one way), feud_end (both ways), grudge_fade a year. F8: p_r by realm, m (Military gain, F2), lv, loy_f. War: war_readiness_min, war_odds (lowered by war_odds_step per Expansion above 2, floor war_odds_min), F9's fortune range, def_seat, loss_k, war_cost (share of stipends), military_drop_every seasons, goal_thresholds, weariness_limit, truce_seasons, failed_attitude, spoils_seasons. F5: k_tax, k_prot, k_rest, loyal_line, break_line; F5b: seek_attitude, seek_lord_attitude, new_lord_loyalty. collapse_seasons: Strained seasons before Collapsing. Values are the GDD's guesses. F5b check 2: rebel_odds (the strength ratio a Defiant vassal needs, with a backer: a great sect at backer_attitude or more to it and at minus that or less to its lord); k_refuse: loyalty lost for a refused levy (a Defiant vassal while its lord is at war); rebel_loyalty_after: a beaten rebel's loyalty. F7's site friction (user decision 2026-11-21): fr_max and fr_v_half, fr = round(fr_max x (1 - 2^(-V / fr_v_half))), V the base output of the border sites. Rule 30: found_chance a season that, in a great sect's territory with fewer minor sects than at the start, a loose cultivator of found_realm_min or above founds one (found_treasury and found_levels to start). Guesses.
